skillFull: Fires a stream of melon soda with her soda pump at certain intervals. The Melon Soda Stream destroys obstacles and creates Melon Fizz Jellies. Collect the Soda Cannon Jelly that appears to fire off a power fan-shaped attack, that destroys more obstacles and creates more Melon Fizz Jellies. Level Up for more points for Melon Fizz Jellies.
story: Platter City, a tireless city filled with countless Cookies' passions and sweetest dreams. This Cookie in particular spends part of her day carting platters of sweet fruit sodas at Cafe Fruit Bomber, but nothing can stop her the moment she catches wind of an interesting rumor spreading around town! Nobody would expect anything less from Melon Soda Cookie, whose endless curiosity and big dreams of influencer fame have her on the move non-stop! Helping the cafe owner on his fixer jobs—whether that means weaving through the alleys of Platter City to find a Cookie's lost dessert birdie or rushing to stop a runaway water boat—was just the beginning. Rumor has it that she even got caught up in a plot that involved finding a prestigious family's lost treasure! When she's caught in a pinch, POW! One blast from her Melon Soda Cannon has everyone floored! You might even catch her making sure the cameras caught the best angle for each refreshing blow. She's still got quite a bit to learn, but just like stacking topping after topping upon a Melon Soda float, she's slowly but surely making her way toward fulfilling her dream! Better get close now, because who knows when she's going to be Platter City's next big influencer!

costumes.info: Watermelon PUNCH, coming right up! What's that, you ask? Why, Cafe Fruit Bomber's new, limited-time summer drink! Melon Soda Cookie's all dressed up for the part, looking sweeter and fresher than the drink itself. She's been busy firing off samples of the new drink from her Soda Cannon, which now has Cookies lined up on the beach for the drink's official release! What a great way to cool off on vacation!
